title: Column Generation for the Micro-Transit Zoning Problem
summary: Along with the rapid development of new urban mobility options like ride-sharing over the past decade, on-demand micro-transit services stand out as a middle ground, bridging the gap between fixed-line mass transit and single-request ride-hailing, balancing ridership maximization and travel time minimization. Micro-transit adoption can have significant social impact.
